Package pl.rentathing.item.mapper

Interface CategoryMapper

public interface CategoryMapper
The CategoryMapper interface provides mapping functionalities between the Category entity and its corresponding DTO, CategoryDto. It simplifies the transformation of Category domain models into transferable objects, particularly DTOs, for use in the application. The interface leverages MapStruct to generate the corresponding implementation at compile time. This mapper follows Spring's component model to support dependency injection.

  • Method Details

    • toDto

      CategoryDto toDto(Category category)
      Maps a Category entity to a CategoryDto. The method copies values from the Category entity, including its id, name, description, iconClass, and calculates the itemCount as the size of the items list in the provided Category. If the items list is null, the itemCount is set to 0.
      Parameters:
      category - the Category entity to be mapped to a CategoryDto. If category is null, the method will return null.
      Returns:
      a CategoryDto containing the mapped values from the input Category. Returns null if the input category is null.
